text: Along a smooth curve on a Riemannian manifold, the metric pairing of two Levi-Civita-parallel vector fields is constant. Thus parallel transport between the endpoint tangent spaces preserves their Riemannian inner products. In a single coordinate chart this pairing is the sum of coordinate components weighted by the metric coefficients.
